items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You know, we do have a little tape with Pansy Lane, Doc, >> [INTERVIEWEE] I mean, Alfred.

ctx.x: You know, we do have a little tape with Pansy Lane, Doc,
Shouldn't say that in front of Papa and Mama Lane. But, uh, Doc Sushan gave it to us. He made it with him for his pass.
